name: NURS 5003
title: Holistic Nursing Practicum
description: Provides students with an opportunity to apply theory from holistic nursing to individuals, families, and community groups in a variety of health care settings. Focus is on relationship-centered holistic care and selected CAM modalities applied across the wellness-illness continuum in collaboration with other members of the health care team. Selected readings, clinical experiences, and practicum project are determined in collaboration with faculty.
requirement_description: NURS 5001 and NURS 5002, which may be taken concurrently.
